summary: Still pinned near the lows into the final 90 minutes: the Sensex is down about 900–1,000 points, the Nifty is near 22,825 and broader indices are off 1.3–1.4%.

detail.leaders: IT only mildly lower; scattered stock-specific gainers
detail.laggards: Banks (Yes Bank, Union Bank, IDFC First), Reliance, realty, metals; MidCap −1.31%, SmallCap −1.43%
detail.tone: Unchanged from 13:30: the last exact print, 22,825.25 (−1.36%) at 1 pm, still describes the tape. Heavyweights like Reliance joining the decline are stopping any afternoon bounce.
watch: A late bounce above 23,000 vs a close near the day's low of 22,819.65
